Genned is built on these open-source libraries and bundles these open-source detector models. Tap an entry for its full license text.

A floating bubble you can tap while inside another app (e.g. Instagram, WhatsApp) to check whatever is currently on screen — including content those apps only let you forward internally, which no share button can reach. This works by capturing the screen (not by reading the other app\'s content or automatically analyzing everything you scroll past), analyzes only when you tap, and is off by default.
Grant \"draw over other apps\" permission first, then turn this back on.
Grant \"usage access\" permission first (so the bubble knows when Instagram/WhatsApp is open), then turn this back on.
Tap the floating bubble over Instagram or WhatsApp to check what\'s on screen.
Genned overlay stopped: screen capture permission ended. Turn the overlay back on in Settings to keep using it.

If the overlay bubble isn\'t behaving right (not appearing over an app, or using more battery than expected), copy the log below and share it — it only contains app package names, timestamps, and the bubble\'s show/hide decisions, never any screen content.

resources.string: No camera capture metadata (make, model, exposure) was found. This is common for both AI-generated images and ordinary photos that were re-saved, screenshotted, or shared through messaging or social apps — it is weak evidence on its own.
No generator metadata found. This does not indicate that the image is authentic — social platforms and messaging apps frequently strip metadata on upload or download.
Image metadata contains a PNG \"parameters\" text chunk, where Stable Diffusion–family tools store generation settings.
Image metadata (%1$s) names an AI image-generation tool.
Image metadata (%1$s) contains AI image-generation parameters.
